name: Dwele
sources: The Independent — Dwele, Jazz Café, London (https://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment/music/reviews/dwele-jazz-cafatildecopy-london-484303.html)
notes: Detroit's self-producing multi-instrumentalist, and the entry puts the hip-hop grid first: "programmed, hip-hop-first — a major hip-hop edge which betrays his original incarnation as a rapper", with "kick on 1 and the 16th before 3, hard snare/clap on 2&4, swung 16th hats with occasional 32nd flams, and a Dilla-lineage tendency to place one drum voice deliberately off the grid". That last clause is why `quantizeStrength` sits at 0.72 rather than at the programmed 0.84 — one voice drifts, not all of them — and the 32nd flams are the roll vocabulary. The stated kick position is the parent's own, so the delta is density and syncopation instead of a restated anchor. His keys are the three the entry names and only those — "D♭ major/D♭ minor and B♭ minor are his home keys — an unusually flat-side catalogue". Harmony is "sample-derived or keyboard-voiced m7/m9 loops of 2–4 bars, minimal cadential motion, and the same chord colour held across a whole section", so no families are authored, `maxChords` drops to 3 and the harmonic rhythm is vamp-weighted. Melody is "soft, mid-register, close-mic'd, low-density and half-spoken", which is the narrow register, density 2–5 and a raised `emptyBarBias`; the one-man arrangement puts his own muted trumpet in the counter. Bass is "round, muted, short-decay electric bass on the root with 8th-note motion", so it mirrors the kick at a high root probability. ⚠ The INFERRED parameters are every drum probability and velocity, the humanize numbers and all melody/bass values. ⚠ The "sub-reinforcement rather than a sustained 808" the entry describes is not authored as a `bass808` block — it reinforces a played bass rather than replacing it. ⚠ The research marks its 136–204 readings as doubled [LOW-CONF]; the folded band is encoded. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 974/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** `melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.22 to 0.1. The counter's note count is `densityRatio` times the lead's own note count, so a bar the lead leaves empty is a bar the counter has nothing to answer — and one empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one, which is the single thing a seed cannot vary. Measured across this roster the models failing this gate average 0.150 here against 0.030 for the models that pass. ⚠ The value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "he plays piano (from age six), trumpet, bass and guitar and stacks them himself, which is the parameter: a one-man arrangement of Rhodes plus his own muted-trumpet countermelody. Loops are 2 or 4 bars; melody is soft, mid-register, close-mic'd, low-density and half-spoken, with dense multi-tracked backgrounds in thirds.", and every claim in it still holds after the change.
